groups.defect: The fallback list accesses SiteSetting.default_locale without guarding nil or lookup failures, and mixes String/Symbol locale identities, defeating deduplication and causing duplicate locale loading.
groups.rationale: s_389b8963, s_df9ce485, and s_08cbca4d share the unguarded default-locale defect; s_df9ce485 additionally reports lookup availability failures. s_08cbca4d also reports the String/Symbol duplication described by s_831e218a, connecting all four through explicit defect overlap.
